description_en: Retrieves aggregated storage metrics over a specified date range, grouped by project or storage class
description_zh: 指定日期查看各个类别的存储信息或各个project的存储信息
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute sum-storage-metrics-by-date --project-names prj --start-date 1715393576201 --end-date 1718590596556 --stats-type PROJECT --region cn-hangzhou
name: SumStorageMetricsByDate

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value must be a timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 结束日期。毫秒级别时间戳。必填参数
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The project names. If this parameter is not specified, the data of all projects is returned
parameters.name: project_names

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value must be a timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 开始日期。毫秒级别时间戳。必填参数
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en:
The dimension for aggregating storage metrics. This parameter is required. Valid values:

`PROJECT`

`STORAGE_TYPE`
parameters.help_zh:
存储用量统计类型。必填参数。包括：
PROJECT
STORAGE_TYPE
parameters.name: stats_type

dateTime.description_en: The date of the statistics. The format is yyyyMMdd

itemStorageMetrics.description_en: The list of storage usage of a specified type
itemStorageMetrics.description_zh: 指定类型的存储用量列表

items.description_en: The storage usage of a specified type

itemName.description_en: If the type is PROJECT, this parameter indicates the project name. If the type is STORAGE_TYPE, this parameter indicates the storage type
itemName.description_zh: 当指定类型为PROJECT时，表示项目名称，当指定类型为STORAGE_TYPE时，表示存储类型

percentage.description_en: The percentage of the storage usage

storageType.description_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

Storage: Standard.

LowFreqStorage: Infrequent Access (IA).

ColdStorage: Archive
storageType.description_zh:
存储类型。包括：
Storage。标准存储。
LowFreqStorage。低频存储。
ColdStorage。长期存储

unit.description_en: The unit of the total storage

httpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

1xx: Informational. The request is received and the process is continuing.

2xx: Success. The request is successfully received, understood, and accepted.

3xx: Redirection. Further action needs to be taken to complete the request.

4xx: Client Error. The request contains bad syntax or cannot be fulfilled.

5xx: Server Error. The server fails to fulfill an apparently valid request
httpCode.description_zh:
HTTP状态码。
1xx：信息响应 - 请求已接收，正在处理中。
2xx：成功 - 请求动作已被服务端成功接收、理解并接受。
3xx：重定向 - 请求被重定向，采取进一步行动以完成请求。
4xx：客户端错误 - 请求包含错误请求参、语法或特定请求条件无法满足。
5xx：服务端错误 - 服务器由于其他原因无法满足请求
